findings.title: 起始金钱绕过资源写入钳制，合法越上限配置可使零价购买减少钱包余额

mandatory_criteria.criterion: WP24明确S=1000000、M=999999的新玩家初值仍为1000000；后续显式写1000000才为999999，不能在创建阶段提前夹限。
区分文本StartMoney十进制非负值校验、元数据缺省3000、内容编辑器0..M选择范围；不把编辑器范围冒充PBS拒绝条件。
保留WP29已有物品→消费统计→件数→金额写回→库存过滤→反馈顺序；零价也执行写回。
具名COINCASE案例保持正常其它依赖：未持有、库存含该物品、可加1、无正价覆盖、UI/回调正常；1000000→999999且物品/件数+1、消费金额+0。
正常3000、恰上限999999分别保持；拒绝确认或列表取消保持1000000且无本次物品/交易统计；先显式金额写入后再免费购买保持999999。
SH-03补余额位于普通写入域及购买成功前提；不可改写已正确WP29§3.2/6.1、PT01写入夹限、SH17价格输入无上限，以及B16/GIR-FD82-B035购买失败只回退件数的限定合同。
新增事实与案例不得声称真实新游戏、默认Demo库存、媒体或UI已执行；未来兼容政策与参考事实分开。

findings.title: 特性候选枚举被误限为两个自然槽，遗漏第三自然候选与隐藏索引冲突

mandatory_criteria.criterion: Correct the shared enumeration rule without changing the already-correct resolver/predicate.
Cover artificial three-natural/empty-hidden, two-natural/empty-hidden and colliding hidden-index cases; expose PATCH message/index/actual identity/consumption separately.
Keep debug H labeling and index-only selection consistent with the corrected shared contract; cross-reference is sufficient and does not demand duplicate algorithms.
Retain normal item guards, successful dependency premises, author-config label and NOT_EXECUTED status.

source_anchors.supporting_fact: 解析索引≥2访问隐藏表，缺项回个人编号最低位；候选枚举却遍历全部自然表并保留其原始索引，然后追加隐藏表的索引+2；自然表第三项会成为索引2候选。
两者都是可重复枚举列表，未声明两个元素的输入上限。
自然/隐藏候选直接采用提供列表，默认分别为空；不截断自然表。
重复枚举读取到所有输入元素；没有固定二项上限。
物种校验处理数值/进化/类型去重及终检，未给Abilities截断或二项拒绝；仅静态调用链，不声称编译已执行。
PATCH从候选列表所有索引2项取最后一个作为消息名；无匹配才拒绝。确认后写索引2并清缓存，实际解析可回落自然槽。CAPSULE只取0/1。
候选全部列出，任何索引≥2标(H)；选择只写索引并清缓存，未直接设置所显示身份。
夹具身份已定义；候选为人工配置而非默认物种数据。
另外两项身份已定义。

findings.original_counterexample: Artificial valid inert base-species data: natural [OVERGROW,CHLOROPHYLL,TORRENT], hidden empty. Enumeration returns (OVERGROW,0),(CHLOROPHYLL,1),(TORRENT,2). This is author configuration, not a claim about a bundled default species.
findings.normal_case: Only two natural entries and no hidden entries: PATCH has no index2 candidate and returns false, consuming none.
failure_or_boundary_case: Three natural entries plus first hidden BLAZE: both (TORRENT,2) and (BLAZE,2) remain in that order; PATCH uses the latter name and resolves BLAZE.

Possible-ability debug lists every pair; every index≥2 gets H, selecting a pair writes its index and clears cache, not its displayed identity. CAPSULE still uses only index0/1 and refuses currently hidden-index individuals.
Confirmation cancel, already-hidden index, ZYGARDE, and invalid referenced identities retain their actual separate failure gates; a valid third entry does not bypass them.

original_counterexample.summary: Legal non-egg FURFROU stored1, forced absent, timestamp integer t, nonbattle/nonstorage, first relevant dynamic read at t+432001, valid preceding scene/data/dependencies: opening summary reaches individual sprite lookup, commits stored0 and clears timestamp before resource matching. Cache clear, recomputation and conditional Pokédex registration follow. Recomputation is an operation, not proof every numeric value changes; later display may populate caches again.
bottle_order: The initial dynamic read returns0 equal to stored0; it performs no form submission or timestamp maintenance.
Prompt-type submission writes requested1 and clears ability cache, then begins the callback before its requested-form handler.

Callback refresh resets the same party member panel/icon. Dynamic form read still sees absent timestamp, returns0, and submits0; inner time handler clears the timestamp, then recomputes and conditionally registers.

Callback message completes. The outer handler receives original requested1 and records the current integer time. It does not rewrite form1. Outer recomputation/registration consume the actual stored0 through the species record; they do not certify form1 as seen.

The item handler returns true; ordinary party utility clears annotations, hard-refreshes, and returns true without consuming this KeyItem. The menu refreshes the selected member once more. Fresh timestamp makes further dynamic reads preserve0. Final observation: stored form0, fresh timestamp, bottle1.

normal_case: HOOPA stored0 with an already-fresh timestamp: ordinary bottle use retains1 and refreshes the timestamp. Absence of timestamp and presence of fresh timestamp are different inputs.
Direct ordinary submission to1 without a middle dynamic read produces1 with a fresh timestamp. This is a contrast entry, not a replacement for the normal party chain.
After the first bottle result0/fresh-time, another normal use within the window retains1; a subsequent1→0 use clears time. No claim that every use or every form item fails.
failure_or_boundary_case: FURFROU at exactly t+432000 does not revert. Battle/storage flags suppress dynamic submission; forced0 returns0 while stored1/t remain. These guards suppress reading-triggered submission, not every explicit form write.
HOOPA stored0 with an already-fresh timestamp: ordinary bottle use retains1 and refreshes the timestamp. Absence of timestamp and presence of fresh timestamp are different inputs.
Direct ordinary submission to1 without a middle dynamic read produces1 with a fresh timestamp. This is a contrast entry, not a replacement for the normal party chain.
After the first bottle result0/fresh-time, another normal use within the window retains1; a subsequent1→0 use clears time. No claim that every use or every form item fails.

Resource failure after a dynamic form read does not imply rollback of an already completed submission; successful final UI/return requires normal dependencies. Real media and host results remain unverified.
